title: AI financial advice is surprisingly good, especially if you ask right questions
summary: MIT Sloan research reveals that AI financial advisors can provide surprisingly competent advice, often comparable to human advisors. The key finding is that the quality of AI-generated financial guidance significantly depends on how users phrase their questions, suggesting a new paradigm where 'prompt engineering' becomes a valuable skill for personal finance management.
problem_solved: Democratizes access to quality financial advice by providing affordable, scalable AI-powered guidance that competes with expensive human financial advisors.
why_valuable: It demonstrates that well-designed AI systems can make professional-grade financial guidance accessible to everyday people, potentially transforming personal finance management for millions who cannot afford traditional advisors.
